title: Forget Freely, Grep Later: Lossless, Index-Free Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.25123v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents often exceed their context windows, forcing them to discard information that may be needed later. Existing context management strategies rely on summarization, masking, or structured memory, requiring decisions about what to preserve or how to retrieve it before future needs are known. However, these methods can introduce lossy compression, potentially discarding details needed for future tasks. To address this limitation, we introduce GrepMem, a simple, lossless, and index-free memory mechanism built on two components: an append-only plain-text log of the agent's complete history and a regular-expression search tool for on-demand recall. Unlike structured memory systems, GrepMem requires no embeddings, retrieval index, memory extraction, or additional models. translated_title: 自由遗忘，随需检索：面向长时程LLM智能体的无损、免索引记忆机制
translated_abstract: 长时程LLM智能体常常超出其上下文窗口的限制，被迫丢弃后续可能需要的信息。现有的上下文管理策略依赖于摘要、掩码或结构化记忆，需要在尚未知晓未来需求的情况下就决定保留什么内容或如何进行检索。然而，这些方法可能引入有损压缩，潜在地丢弃未来任务所需的细节。为解决这一局限，我们提出了GrepMem，这是一种简单、无损且免索引的记忆机制，由两个组件构成：一个记录智能体完整历史的仅追加纯文本日志，以及一个用于按需召回的正则表达式搜索工具。与结构化记忆系统不同，GrepMem不需要嵌入向量、检索索引、记忆提取或额外的模型。我们在五种上下文管理策略下通过强化学习训练Qwen3.5-9B，并在多问题研究会话、长流等场景上进行评估。
tldr: 该论文提出GrepMem，一种由仅追加纯文本日志和正则表达式搜索工具组成的无损、免索引记忆机制，使长时程LLM智能体无需摘要、嵌入或结构化记忆即可完整保存历史并按需检索信息。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GrepMem, a lossless, index-free memory mechanism built on an append-only plain-text log and a regex search tool, enabling long-horizon LLM agents to preserve complete history and recall information on demand without summarization, embeddings, or structured memory.
